positions.title: Sr. Web Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Develops and maintains web applications while providing innovative solutions. Work with middle-tier/server side, and database admin to complete interactions between front end user facing application components and server-side components.
•	Work on proof of concepts using new applications or technologies.
•	Work with designers to bring life to designs from Figma wireframes.
•	Document technical designs. Aide in defect resolution through troubleshooting
•	SQL and Database experience with queried data, created tables and stored procedures in SQL Server, SQL Server Studio 18.
•	NoSQL – MongoDB experience (create collection, insert, find, filter, sort, delete, update, limit result, drop collection, join collections) 
•	RedHat OpenShift Container experience (create Image, Pod, Secret, Route)
•	Node.js, Express.js API server (connection to SQL server)
•	GitHub, Git experience (clone, fetch, merge pull, push)
•	Development using React JS, HTML, CSS, Javascript, JQuery, Handlebars, JSON, AJAX, XML, XSLT, XPATH
•	Development using SPA framework (React JS, Hooks, Express JS) and exposed to Next.js
•	Experience with React.js, Require.js, Node.js, SASS, Bootstrap, CSS3 Media Query.
•	Experience in Mail form, Salesforce form, Database form, Eloqua form.
•	Knowledge of Responsive Design, Colorbox, Brightcove video.
•	Experience with IBM (FUZE) Web Content Management, JIRA project management.
•	Proficient in cross-browser troubleshooting (IE, Chrome, Firefox)
•	Knowledgeable in web standards and browser compatibility
•	Ability to work on multiple projects with quick turn-around
•	Experience with analytics, feature flag, and experimentation tools such as Google Tag Manager, and Adobe Analytics.
•	Experience building websites to meet WCAG ADA compliance standards.
Environment: HTML, React, Javascript, CSS, JQuery, XML, XSLT, SQL Server IBM (FUZE) Web Content and  JIRA project management, Openshift

positions.description:

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
•	Performed ad hoc database analysis across multiple database platforms including Access, SQL server, Oracle as well as consolidate information from multiple mainframe platforms
•	Modified existing and create new stored procedures, tables, views reports
•	Implemented documentation for each task that had completed
Environment: Access, SQL, Visual Basic, Teradata, EDW, Excel, Word, Outlook

positions.title: Database/Report Specialist
positions.description:
•	Created Access databases and maintained existing applications. 
•	Designed, developed ad hoc and customized reports including extraction, validation and analysis.
•	Modified existing and create new stored procedures, tables, views reports
•	Updated provider data and investigated flagged issues of claim payment process
Environment: Access, SQL, VB, Sagent data flow, Excel, Word, Outlook, UNET, COSMOS,   EPD, SIU
